_comment: Scheduled jobs for GitHub Actions. collect: daily download into the market-data branch. research: weekly walk-forward on the stored history. Set enabled=false to pause a job. Sources were chosen with the 'Data source probe' workflow.

collect._comment: US: SMTK and Nasdaq small/mid-cap peers, Russell 2000 ETF as benchmark.
Borsa Istanbul via Yahoo's .IS listings (BIST30 + other long-listed large caps), BIST 100 index as benchmark.
TCMB EVDS: USD/TRY and EUR/TRY reference rates (needs the EVDS_API_KEY secret).
Stooq answered 404 from GitHub's runners in the probe of 2026-10-26; kept for later re-checks.
Alternative BIST source: needs a reachable bist-data-service (BIST_DATA_SERVICE_URL secret).

research._comment: Screened: at least 8 years listed, median daily traded value >= 20M USD over the last year, <=5% zero-volume days, data not behind the others.
research.name: smtk_peers

research._comment: Screened: at least 8 years listed, median daily traded value >= 500M TL over the last year (nominal TL: raise it with inflation), <=5% zero-volume days, data not behind the others.
research.name: bist_likit
